scenario: [LUNI.4.1.5]: "Two declarations are two, whatever their names, storage types and units, so a value of one meeting a value of the other is [LUNI.8.2]'s error." `a` and `b` each declare a dimension `warmth`, and a rule compares a slot of each. A compiler comparing bare names sees one dimension and compiles it. PATH PINNED: `dsc.imports.limp_1_5_unit`, which stamps each `warmth` with the library declaring it, then `dsc.typecheck`'s comparison.
rules_ds:
import a
import b

rule r:
    a.Ta x
    b.Tb y where x.t == y.t
->
    log info "x"

libraries.a:
unit dimension warmth storage float64 base ta_unit
unit ta_unit: warmth

schema Ta scope logical:
    k: Int key
    t: ta_unit mutable
libraries.b:
unit dimension warmth storage float64 base tb_unit
unit tb_unit: warmth

schema Tb scope logical:
    k: Int key
    t: tb_unit mutable
